themes.description: Bright and crisp for kitchens and sunny rooms.

themes.name: Warm
themes.description: Earthy dark tones for living spaces.

themes.name: Mono
themes.description: Black and white with thick borders. Readable across the room.

themes.name: Glass

components.name: Alarm panel
components.description: Arm or disarm an alarm. Always asks before acting.

components.name: Blinds
components.description: Open, stop and close blinds, curtains or a garage door, or set how far open they are.

components.name: Camera snapshot
components.description: A still image from a camera that refreshes every few seconds.

components.name: Energy gauge
components.description: A power reading on a dial with a limit you choose.

components.name: Fan
components.description: Turn a fan on or off, or set it to half speed.

components.name: Light tile
components.description: Turn a light on or off and see its brightness.

components.name: Light with slider
components.description: A light switch with a brightness slider.

components.name: Lock
components.description: Lock or unlock a door. Always asks before acting.

components.name: Media player
components.description: What is playing, with its picture, play, pause and skip buttons, and the volume.

components.name: Presence chips
components.description: Who is home, with a picture for each person.

components.name: Room summary
components.description: Temperature, humidity and lights for one room, with a link to its page.

components.name: Scene row
components.description: One button for each scene you pick.

components.name: Sensor graph
components.description: The last 24 hours of a sensor as a line.

components.name: Sensor value
components.description: One sensor reading in large type.

components.name: Thermostat
components.description: Set one target temperature and see what the heating is doing. Heating and cooling together, with a low and a high target, is not supported yet.

components.name: Weather
components.description: Current conditions and the next five days.
